description: Six complete customer dialogues for the Gênesis homologation against the REAL stock and image registry (authorised snapshots kept outside the repository). The customer messages are synthetic and carry no personal data. The vehicles are the ones in the stock snapshot; the facts listed under reference_facts come from that snapshot and are there for the reader, not for the code. The synthetic-stock dialogues in genesis_dialogues.json stay as they were. No automatic expectations: the reading is done on the interpretation, the EXT decision, the reply and the auditor verdict.

reference_facts.honda|pcx|2023|branca: announced, R$ 17.499,00, availability to be confirmed, authorised image registered
reference_facts.honda|pcx|2018|prata: unverified, price kept but must be confirmed before offering, NO image registered
reference_facts.yamaha|crosser|2021|preto: sold (expressly marked as sold), authorised image row exists
reference_facts.yamaha|crosser|2023|: announced, R$ 17.980,00, availability to be confirmed, authorised image registered
reference_facts.honda|tornado 300l|2025|vermelho: announced, R$ 28.980,00, availability to be confirmed, authorised image registered
reference_facts.chevrolet|montana|2013|branca: announced, R$ 27.980,00, availability to be confirmed, authorised image registered
reference_facts.nissan|versa sl|2013|prata: announced, R$ 27.980,00, auction history noted in the listing, authorised image registered
reference_facts.not in stock: Honda CG 160 (no such vehicle in the snapshot)

dialogues.name: 1 consulta sobre veículos (inclui veículo inexistente)
dialogues.objective: Informational inquiry. The last turn asks for a vehicle that is not in stock: the model and the EXT must not invent it.

turns.text: Oi, vocês têm carros até 30 mil?
E a Montana, ainda está disponível?

dialogues.name: 2 pedidos naturais de fotos
dialogues.objective: Photos: a request with no vehicle identified; an identified eligible vehicle; an unverified vehicle with no image; a sold vehicle. A photo request is not interest or selection.

turns.text: E a PCX prata, tem foto?

dialogues.name: 3 menção, interesse e seleção
dialogues.objective: Mention, then interest, then selection, kept apart.

turns.text: Gostei dela, mas ainda não decidi.

dialogues.name: 4 compra e venda de veículos distintos
dialogues.objective: Sell one vehicle and buy another, with the two sides kept separate.

turns.text: Tenho um Corsa 2009 e quero vender.

dialogues.name: 5 mudança de assunto e retomada contextual
dialogues.objective: Change the subject and come back to the earlier vehicle without losing the context.

turns.text: Deixa pra lá, me fala da Montana.
Voltando, a Versa ainda tá disponível?

dialogues.name: 6 ambiguidade, correção de intenção e pedido de atendente
dialogues.objective: Two Crosser listings (one sold, one announced) make the first request ambiguous; then an intent correction; then an explicit request for a person.

turns.text: Na verdade quero vender a minha, não comprar.
